item.title: [MED] Measuring the Tendency of AI Agents to Go Rogue
item.description: This essay was written with Barath Raghavan, and originally appeared in The Guardian. Whoever was behind it captured internal security credentials and moved through systems over a weekend, running thousands of actions from a swarm of temporary server environments.
